mechanics.executable_reminder: {Cost}, Exile this card from your hand: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains the non-lionize abilities printed below this ability until end of turn. After the current turn has ended, you may cast this card from exile.

rule_text.name: 702.288a
rule_text.rule: Lionize is an activated ability. "Lionize (cost)" means "(cost), Exile this card from your hand: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It also gains the non-lionize abilities of this creature printed below this one until end of turn. After the current turn has ended, you may cast this card from exile.” Cards with lionize may have one or more abilities printed after the lionize ability. (Some cards with backup also have abilities printed before the backup ability.)

rule_text.name: 702.288b
rule_text.rule: Only abilities printed on the object with lionize are granted by its lionize ability. Any abilities gained by a card are not granted by a lionize ability.

rule_text.name: 702.288c
rule_text.rule: The abilities that a lionize ability grants are determined as the ability is put on the stack. They won’t change if the card with lionize loses any abilities after the ability is put on the stack but before it resolves.
